# Informed operator-arrow first study

The active 0.3.0 plan requires an operator/capability/Meaning decision group
under Issues 83, 45, 46, 57 and 89, composed with Basis Issue 44. This study
was authored after reading those design questions, current source contracts,
the parser, body-effect implementation and selected-source CLI. It is informed
research, not a blind benchmark. Codex authored it; the exact deployed model
identifier and sampling settings are unavailable. No external model is invoked.

Existing first-order controls and deliberate negatives are distinguished from
unadopted Op arrow and closure spelling candidates. The comma slot currently
names Meaning. This packet adopts no syntax or constitutional interpretation.
No parser rejection is evidence about later owners, phase, capabilities or
native acceptance. Intended equations below are independent obligations, not
claims that this check command proved them. General source preservation,
QS/PR/quantitative RS and EXACT duties remain pending; both admitted QLV1
meanings and native definitions remain unchanged.

Every project is frozen before its first invocation, uses an explicit valid
schema-2 edition-2026 manifest, and contains at most one physical input qubit.
Only bounded check observations are requested; no maximum-size case is added.
